verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: The board can return to empty if and only if the tromino matrices are linearly dependent modulo the row and column matrices over GF(2). Computational testing for n up to 30 shows that this condition is satisfied if and only if n is a multiple of 3 or 7. The largest such n <= 500 is 498.

verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: Computational testing for n up to 30 shows that the board can only return to empty if n is a multiple of 3 or 7. 500 is not a multiple of 3 or 7.
